data.title: Instant Payment Velocity Spike Above 30-Day Baseline
data.description: Detects a sudden spike in instant payment frequency that significantly exceeds the account's established 30-day baseline. A spike is defined as the current day's instant payment count exceeding 3 standard deviations above the rolling 30-day mean, indicating potential account compromise or mule activity where the account is being drained rapidly.

detection.condition: selection | count() by account_id | compare(op=gt, period=30d, stdev=3)

falsepositives: Small business owner processing seasonal surge in vendor payments
Customer making multiple legitimate payments on a move-in day (deposits, utilities, services)
